question: In the year 2021, the Department of Public Enterprises has now been made part of the __________ Ministry, to speed up the privatisation process and exercise greater financial control over the state-run-enterprises.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Finance**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Department of Public Enterprises was integrated into the **Ministry of Finance** in 2021.
 
• This move was aimed at accelerating the privatisation process and enabling greater financial oversight over state-run enterprises.
